'''Rusha''' was an elderly [[Gender/Legends|woman]] who was a person of great importance on [[Eckless]]. She was considered the leading candidate to be elected [[President/Legends|President]] of the [[Council of Eckless]].<ref name="TBS" />

Once [[Hahz Fallone]] arrived and subjugated the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], she led the uprising that drove him off the planet. She spearheaded the efforts to build a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] so she could pursue him and bring him to justice.<ref name="TBS" />

She found him on [[Chazwa/Legends|Chazwa]], and offered a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] of 5,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for the return of a valuable artifact called the [[Black Sphere]]. She also offered a matching bounty if Fallone was captured so she could return him to Eckless to face justice. She was killed by a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] named [[Jorga Sune]] before she could get her revenge on Fallone.<ref name="TBS" />
